subject: Computação
description_pt: Identificar a adequação de diferentes tecnologias computacionais na resolução de problemas.

components.description_pt: Identificar diferentes tipos de tecnologias computacionais usadas para resolver problemas
components.description_en: Identify different types of computational technologies used to solve problems
components.cc_component_description: Identify wave-based technologies used in everyday life and scientific research

components.description_pt: Avaliar a adequação de tecnologia computacional específica para um problema dado
components.description_en: Evaluate the appropriateness of a given computational technology for a specific problem
components.cc_component_description: Justify the selection of a data-collection method based on accuracy and appropriateness for a given investigation

components.description_pt: Comparar tecnologias computacionais baseado em sua adequação para resolver problema dado
components.description_en: Compare computational technologies based on their suitability for solving a given problem
components.cc_component_description: Compare proposed solutions based on how well each addresses the problem criteria

cc_matches.description: Multiple technologies based on the understanding of waves and their interactions with matter are part of everyday experiences in the modern world (e.g., medical imaging, communications, scanners) and in scientific research. They are essential tools for producing, transmitting, and capturing signals and for storing and interpreting the information contained in them.
Generate and/or compare multiple solutions to a problem.
Evaluate the accuracy of various methods for collecting data.
